items.name: Potion of Cure Serious Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 3d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15).

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +2
items.description: This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).

items.name: Potion of Air Bubble
items.description:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st

Air bubble creates a small pocket of breathable air that surrounds the touched creature's head or the touched object. The air bubble allows the creature touched to breathe underwater or in similar airless environments, or protects the object touched from water damage. items.name: Thoracic Nanite Chamber (Mark I)
items.description:
Description
A thoracic nanite chamber augments the vital organs within a creature's chest, particularly its heart, lungs, and pulmonary system. Once installed, a thoracic nanite chamber grants an enhancement bonus to Constitution.

items.name: Cyberfiber Muscles (Mark I)
items.description:
Description
Cyberfiber muscles are powerful synthetic muscles that augment but do not replace existing muscle mass in a creature. Once installed, cyberfiber muscles grant an enhancement bonus to Strength. This enhancement bonus alters price, implantation value, install DCs, and Craft DCs as listed below.

items.name: Potion of Cure Light Wounds
items.description:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 1st

Spell Description
When laying your hand upon a living creature, you channel positive energy that cures 1d8 points of damage +1 point per caster level (maximum +5). Since undead are powered by negative energy, this spell deals damage to them instead of curing their wounds. An undead creature can apply Spell Resistance, and can attempt a Will save to take half damage.

items.name: Cybernetic Ears
items.description:
Source Technology Guide pg. 37
Price 4,000 gp
Slot ears; Weight 1 lb.
Install DC 28; Implantation 1
DescriptionA cybernetic ear can be enhanced by cyberart at no additional cost, giving it an unusual color or shape. When a pair of ears is installed, the user gains a +2 circumstance bonus on Perception checks. This bonus stacks with circumstance bonuses on Perception checks from other cybernetic senses. Cybernetic ears grant a +4 resistance bonus on all saving throws against sonic effects.

items.name: Potion of Cure Moderate Wounds
items.description: This spell functions like cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10).

items.name: Implant Mesh (Mark II)
items.description:
Description

An implant mesh is a cybernetic augmentation that enhanced other cybernetic implants, notably those that heighten their wearers' physical abilities. If used to enhance cyberfiber musclesTG, a thoracic nanite chamberTG, or wirejack tendonsTG, an implant mesh must be installed on that piece of cyberware before the item is implanted in a body. 

 

This implant mesh supports up to 3 physical body mods with a maximum bonus of +2.

items.name: Dermal Plating (Mark II)
items.description:
Description
These plates exist under the skin and provide increased resistance to physical attacks. They are undetectable normally, but are visible when struck and for a few moments afterwords.

items.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
items.description: The subject and all its gear become insubstantial, misty, and translucent. Its material armor (including natural armor) becomes worthless, though its size, Dexterity, deflection bonuses, and armor bonuses from force effects still apply. The subject gains DR 10/ magic and becomes immune to poison, sneak attacks, and critical hits. items.name: Cardiac Accelerator
items.description: Allows a haste-effect to be activated as a swift-action. The amount of rounds per day is hd/2 + Con Mod. The number of rounds is chosen as part of the swift action.

items.name: Wirejack Tendons (Mark II)
items.description:
Description
Wirejack tendons not only strengthen and enhance existing reflexes, but also enhance the transmission of nerve impulses to surrounding musculature. Once installed, wirejack tendons grant an enhancement bonus to Dexterity.

items.name: Ring of Protection +2
items.description: This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.
